description: This file defines a RecyclerView adapter (RecipeListAdapter) for displaying a list of Recipe objects in an Android application, handling view creation, data binding, and user interactions such as item clicks and toggling favorites.

classes.name: RecipeListAdapter
classes.description: A RecyclerView adapter for displaying recipes with functionality to handle item clicks and favorite toggling.

methods.name: onCreateViewHolder
methods.description: Inflates the item view layout and creates a ViewHolder.

methods.name: getItemCount
methods.description: Returns the number of recipe items.

methods.name: onBindViewHolder
methods.description: Binds recipe data to the view holder, including setting images, text, and click listeners.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates the adapter's data set with new items and refreshes the view.

methods.name: VH
methods.description: ViewHolder class holding references to item views.
